caption:
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The signs of a hypocrite are three: Whenever he speaks, he tells a lie; and whenever he promises, he breaks his promise; and whenever he is entrusted, he betrays (proves to be dishonest)."

Sahih al-Bukhari 6095. Day 2 of our series on what Islam says about promises, covenants and pledges. Swipe for the Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Hadith #Promises #Trustworthiness #IslamicReminder #Deen

sourcing.primary_text: Sahih al-Bukhari 6095 (hadith-api numbering; Book 78, Hadith 122). Series: what Islam says about promises, covenants and pledges.
sourcing.arabic_and_english: Live-fetched twice on 2026-10-13 from cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api@1/editions/ara-<collection> and eng-<collection>, HTTP 200, the two fetches diffed identical. Slides written programmatically from the API text.
sourcing.arabic_extraction: Arabic slide shows the Prophet's words only (the text between the quotation marks); the chain of narrators is omitted from the slide, not altered. Invisible RLM/RLE control marks removed.
sourcing.english_artifact_note: API English text omitted the closing period and quotation mark when applicable; restored punctuation only, no wording changed. 'Narrated X:' prefix kept as 'Narrated X: '.
sourcing.grade: hadith-api supplies no grade for this edition (grades empty); slide states only the collection. Sahih al-Bukhari / Sahih Muslim collections are the sources, no grade is claimed beyond that.
sourcing.chinese_korean_japanese_malay_thai_spani: hadith-api has no Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai or Spanish edition (checked editions.json 2026-10-13). These six slides are Claude's own careful translation from the verified Arabic and English, labelled on-slide as such; no scholar is named.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against all string terms in compliance-policy.json halal section across English and translations: 0 hits. No imagery.
